{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
data_final = data_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = data_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
conversion_email = conversion_by_channel['email']
conversion_paid_search = conversion_by_channel['paid_search']

# Mean revenue by channel
mean_revenue_by_channel = data_final.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
revenue_email = mean_revenue_by_channel['email']
revenue_paid_search = mean_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']

# Overall conversion rate
overall_conversion = data_final['converted'].mean()

# Summary
print(f'Conversion rate (email): {conversion_email:.4f}')
print(f'Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_paid_search:.4f}')
print(f'Mean revenue (email): ${revenue_email:.2f}')
print(f'Mean revenue (paid_search): ${revenue_paid_search:.2f}')
print(f'Overall conversion rate: {overall_conversion:.4f}')"}
